verdict.rationale: Cognee documents an official MCP server, Cognee MCP, that brings persistent memory to MCP-compatible assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue and Codex. A probe confirmed the official MCP overview page exists, so an agent can connect directly to Cognee's memory. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the exposed MCP tools, setup and transport options, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.
